newsitem.title: USA: Southtrust to buy 12 Fla branches.
newsitem.headline: Southtrust to buy 12 Fla branches.

text.p: SouthTrust Corp and Home Savings of America, a subsidiary of H.F. Ahmanson & Co, said on Tuesday that they have signed a definitive agreement for the purchase of 12 Savings of America branches by SouthTrust Bank of Florida, N.A.
The branches, with $974 million in deposits, are located on the west coast of Florida.
Home Savings of America said that the sale of the branches is part of its ongoing efforts to consolidate its deposit-gathering activities.
The sale, which is subject to certain conditions and regulatory approvals, has been scheduled to be completed during the second quarter of 1997.
SouthTrust Bank of Florida N.A., currently operates 157 banking locations in Florida with total assets of more than $5 billion as of December 31, 1996.
